content.title: INTEGRATED VALIDATION ENVIRONMENT
content.content: SnapLogic's built-in Validation mode allows developers to execute pipelines at design time and inspect the data output at every Snap before promotion to test or production. Validation runs entirely within the Ground Plex — no data leaves the AH data center boundary. Validation data is not persisted by the platform; it is discarded at the end of the validation session. For security-sensitive environments such as Airbus Helicopters', validation should be performed against representative sample or synthetic data rather than live production data — consistent with standard integration development practice.
